question: Suppose \(n\ge2\) is a fixed positive integer and \(f(x)=x^n|x|,\ x\in\mathbb R.\) Then

options.A: \(f\) is differentiable everywhere only when \(n\) is even
options.B: \(f\) is differentiable everywhere except at 0 if \(n\) is odd
options.D: none of the above is true.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
